payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance results for various models and datasets, allowing for a clear summary of their performance outcomes.

claims.text: Oversampled datasets (F+, T+, W+) show significantly better performance than their counterparts (F, T, W).
DNN models achieved an accuracy score of 78.5%.
BLSTM with attention achieved F1 scores of 0.94 for two datasets using feature level transfer learning.
DNN models with transfer learning outperformed the best-known results for all three datasets.
